message.content: {"needs_revision": true, "reasoning": "The code has a critical data leakage bug: the stacker is fit on OOF predictions from base models that were trained on folds, but the final base models are refit on the full training data, meaning the stacker's input distribution at inference differs from training. More critically, the OOF stacking uses cross-validation on training data which is fine, but the stacker itself is trained on OOF predictions while final base models see all data, creating a mismatch. Additionally, the freq_maps for occupation are computed on full training data before the CV split, which is a minor leakage into the OOF fold training. I will fix the occupation frequency encoding to be computed per-fold during OOF and store the full-data version only for final refit.", "revised_code": null}
